data.name: NEC PC-8853 / JC-1410P2-class colour display assembly

specification.historical_raster: 640x400, 24.83 kHz horizontal, 56.4/55.4 Hz vertical; stock digital RGB input.
specification.adaptation: OEM tube/yoke/deflection assembly plus qualified 26.88 kHz/60 Hz progressive adaptation and AION palette/DAC electronics. Stock monitor is not plug-compatible; historical shipment does not prove OEM contract or modified timing qualification.
